name: GenericResult
description:
A tool's browser preview (AiToolCallResultPreview) rendered schema-first: the disclosure
picks table, detail, value or redaction, and recognised Glass UX types upgrade to entity
cards and lists (resolvePreview).

props.name: preview
props.description: The tool's raw preview: its JSON `value` (or `null` when withheld), disclosure hints and preview cap, resolved to a result with the entity resolver.
